author: KikiV2
body:
I can't appeal on that account, that's why I'm writing this here. Please actually read.
Okay, so, This is not about hacking, nothing like that. This is just an Account Switching misunderstanding.

Some players on this server may know me as KikiMaloo, I used to play on that account, I even got into Jalapeños team, everything good.
The problem is that, that account was those account sold by 2$ or so, I thought some guy didn't want to play Mc anymore or something like that so tried to make money out of it by selling his account, I bought it. Some day I wanted to get an Optifine cape*, but I had to change the email of KikiMaloo, I tried, but it didn't work, the account was taken or something like that and I thought I was scammed. 

I could not get the account back, for the account was not bought by me. I did a post, saying what happened and that I was moving to this account as you can read here -> https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/c057e137c

Now. I changed, to this one, but it doesn't end here. 

Because I'm stupid I bought this account by 2$ dollars too, and basically the same thing happened, trying to change the Gmail, it was taken, but this time the guy texted me back and I talked to him. I realized that these cheap Minecraft accounts are not people who quit playing and sold them, they are stolen accounts. 

What's next? Knowing this, I couldn't get 26$ dollars for a game because my mom wouldn't let me do so, I spent like 3 months or 2 without playing any Minecraft. Until this week, February 26th was my birthday and my father gave me permission to use his credit card to buy something less than 100$, and I, of course, asked for a Minecraft account and more stuff, I finally got an official Minecraft, my own, only mine, this account is known as SibMaj7.

Now here is why I'm posting this.
I was playing yesterday for the first time in what for me looked like 4 months but it was less actually, and I saw many people playing on the server, some of them friends (Who knew what happened to me because they were in Jalapeños) and of course I was like "BRO IT'S ME, KIKIMALOO DO YOU REMEMBER ME!? :DD"

Guess what.  A mod thought I was Ban evading because he didn't take his time to read what I posted on KikiMaloo (which is banned because I asked to remove it from the server when I thought it was stolen)  and ended up permanently banning me in my first hours of playing on my new account, I wasn´t registered and because of that, I can't appeal on SibMaj7, great isn't it? C:

So now you now what happened, I'm not ban evading, nothing like that, I'm a normal player now, and I love this server so much, I ask you to unban SibMaj7 -> https://avicus.net/SibMaj7

I tried to contact like 4 mods and no one answered me pinche gobierno puto, so that´s why I'm posting this on my 2nd attempt.

So in that context, KikiMaloo wasn't stolen, rather than that I was taken back actually, same with this one, but I still have this one registered on Avicus by now and I may even return it back.

Thanks if you actually read.


BTW: I speak fluent Spanish and Portuguese and italian is coming so, I can be a translator too, but first I need SibMaj7 to be unbanned.

I've appealed the ban on https://avicus.net/SibMaj7. I'm glad you were able to finally get an account to play on Avicus, sorry about this most recent ban though.
